purpose: Test whether a valid initial state with identical, ideal primary/monitor estimates can leave the closed position union under the original bounded LQR and old geometric gate.
selection_rule: Exactly one deterministic midpoint initial state from the E005 bounded initial-state box; both HCW and nonlinear central-gravity plants. No outcome-selected added cases.
information: Both snapshots equal simulated planar state; no filter, measurement noise or fault injection. This differs from historical campaigns.
actuation: Original saturated LQR and original gate; no actuator uncertainty or external process acceleration.
plant_implementations: Byte-verified original E004 augmented-exponential HCW; byte-verified original E005 inertial RK4 and frame transforms.
convergence_rule: Generate nonlinear closed-loop commands at .1 s maximum step once. Replay exactly that fixed command sequence at .05 and .025 and through separately implemented relative-frame DOP853. Preserve all results.
adjudication: Independent Boolean closed-union membership and signed excess evaluated on .25 s observation grid. First observed violation brackets, not exact event times; no containment conclusion from absent sampled violations.
recording: Every command, state, original gate reason, union predicate, original-predicate value and finite check; no terminal command at 300 s.
cache_adapter: Increase only pure HCW matrix memoization capacity to 32768; do not change computed formulas or source bytes.
state_fixture_interpretation: Constructed outside-union state for non-implication; never counted as a reachable historical point.
stop_rule: Retain all selected cases. On computational failure record it and do not replace the case.
